title_en: Jobs (10/20): A Police Officer on Patrol
note_en: 连……都/也…… means "even" and marks the most extreme or unexpected case: 他连车都不要了 "he even abandoned the bike," 连身份证都是假的 "even his ID card was fake." Unlike English "even," which can float around the sentence, Chinese puts 连 directly before the surprising item and 都 or 也 directly before the verb or predicate, so the two words frame the point being stressed.
